lead_raw_text:
The structure of V3Bi crystallizes in the cubic space group Pm-3m (No. 221), with a unit cell containing four atoms and two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Bi and V centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors per atom, at a uniform neighbor distance of 3.0893 Å. The Bi center is surrounded by 12 V neighbors, while V has 4 Bi and 8 V neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate that V-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra share corners, edges, and faces, and Bi–V pairs share edges.
